en: The postcard features a bustling street scene with several people, including children, standing and interacting along a narrow street lined with classic European buildings. Dominating the background is a large, ornate church tower with a tall spire and smaller spires, typical of Gothic or neo-Gothic architecture. The sky is blue with a textured, almost painted appearance. At the top of the image, the words 'Bloemerstraat' and 'NIJMEGEN.' are printed, indicating the location depicted.
